title: File:Berlin, Mitte, Gipsstrasse 6, Mietshaus 01.jpg
desc: Residential building at Gipsstraße No. 6 in Berlin-Mitte. The house was built in 1865. The facade was reconstructed around 1980. The house is part of the protected historic buildings area Spandauer Vorstadt.
